title: Spectral Decontamination of a Venetian Artifact
description: A corroded Venetian mask sits inside a chemistry fume hood. The user must mix reagent solutions through a dispersion apparatus to produce specific spectral wavelengths, then direct the purified light beams onto contaminated regions of the mask to neutralize chemical deposits. Conservation of reagent volume is enforced, and each mixing step is reversible via undo/redo.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (importmap from cdn.jsdelivr.net). Load DispersionTest.glb as a prism-and-cuvette dispersion apparatus on the left side of a lab bench, and venice_mask.glb as a corroded artifact mounted on a stand to the right. Use OrbitControls with a default camera at position (0, 2, 5) looking at center. Add warm directional light plus cool ambient light to simulate a lab environment. The mask must have 5 highlighted contamination zones (glowing red emissive patches on different face regions). The dispersion apparatus has 3 virtual reagent reservoirs (R, G, B) each starting at 100 mL displayed in a HUD. The user clicks a reservoir then clicks the apparatus cuvette to pour a measured 10 mL dose, reducing that reservoir. Multiple pours mix additively following RGB color mixing. A beam of the resulting color emits from the apparatus prism toward the mask. The user clicks a contamination zone to target it; if the beam color matches the zone's required complementary color within a tolerance, the zone cleans (emissive fades to gold). Conservation law: total volume across all reservoirs plus cuvette always equals 300 mL. A drain button empties the cuvette back proportionally to reservoirs. Implement full undo/redo stack (Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Shift+Z) that reverts every pour and drain action, restoring volumes and beam color. Require 10-14 steps to clean all 5 zones since some need multi-reagent mixes. Show a step counter HUD. When all zones are clean, play a sparkle particle effect on the mask and display a completion banner. Add subtle ambient particle dust in the scene. All UI uses HTML overlay divs styled with semi-transparent dark panels and monospace font.
